ننمحص (form VII)
# نَنْمَحِصُ (nanmaḥiṣu) /nan.ma.ħi.sˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْمَحَصَ (inmaḥaṣa)
# نَنْمَحِصَ (nanmaḥiṣa) /nan.ma.ħi.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَحَصَ (inmaḥaṣa)
# نَنْمَحِصْ (nanmaḥiṣ) /nan.ma.ħisˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْمَحَصَ (inmaḥaṣa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
